_comment: CANONICAL registry of the AICOM live demo deployment on Base mainnet. Single source of truth for deployed contract addresses, mirrored by chain_net.py (_BASE_ADDRESSES, Python) and argus/src/ecosystem/networks.ts (BASE_MAINNET_ADDRESSES, TS). The human-readable record (with every deployment transaction) is docs/onchain-journal.md. A test (test_base_deployment_registry.py) asserts this file, the journal, and the ARGUS constant stay in sync — so docs and code cannot diverge. Addresses are PUBLIC (on-chain, verified on Basescan); committing them is safe. They auto-load as the default for chain=base when AIFACTORY_CRYPTO_ENABLED=1; any AIMARKET_ADDR_BASE_<NAME> env var overrides. The payment RECIPIENT wallet is deliberately NOT defaulted here — it must be set explicitly per deployment so funds never silently route to the demo owner. Redeployed 2026-07-26 from 0x1218…Ad0a.
